title: Silver Purchase and Sale Profit
takeaway: A silver investor can calculate their profit or loss based on purchase and sale prices.

data.label: Purchase Price
data.evidence: You purchase 10 American Silver Eagles on July 15th for $100 each, totaling $1,000.

data.label: Sale Price
data.evidence: You sell those coins on December 20th for $120 each, receiving $1,200.

narration: This bar chart illustrates the profit generated by selling silver coins. The purchase price was $1,000, and the sale price was $1,200, resulting in a profit of $200.
